elements.manual_reason: No candidate isolates the stapler's top arm; b02 covers only the hinge knob at right and b03 the front of the base.
elements.label: Stapler arm pressed shut

sfx_review.label: click
sfx_review.note: Sharp broadband transient landing as the hand drives the stapler arm down (around f1801-f1804); a mechanical stapler click, not a glitch.

pattern.description: Macro live-action insert: a hand comes down fast and presses a chrome stapler shut, shallow depth of field, locked-off camera.
pattern.why_premium: A tight macro insert with a crisp synced click punctuates the story beat (decisive, frustrated action) and keeps the edit rhythm tight between wider shots.

build_hint.gsap: Not a graphics build: place the clip as a <video> layer on the HyperFrames timeline and align the click SFX to the press frame; for a synthetic version use gsap.to(arm, {rotation:8, transformOrigin:'right center', duration:0.15, ease:'power3.in'}) with the hand tweening y in parallel.
build_hint.remotion: Use <OffthreadVideo> in a <Sequence>; for a synthetic version interpolate arm rotate over ~4 frames with Easing.in(Easing.cubic) and put the click <Audio> on the contact frame.

notes: Live-action macro shot; camera.move none. The b02 OCR text is noise off the stapler chrome, not on-screen text.
